column1: # Reviewed binary operations; names are descriptive, not recovered source/linkage names.
# These observations do not map a source declaration, excuse a difference, or close any caller.
# Source names remain owned by ordinary declarations and MAC_ADDRESS annotations.

column6: evidence
Scans 0x4000 eight-byte entries for a null resource, hashes resource+4 through 0x15216c, stores hash/pointer and increments count at +0x20000. Windows addToCache uses TCacheMap::insert.
Scans the same 0x4000-entry cache for pointer equality, clears both words and decrements count. resource::dispose calls it; Windows erases a TCacheMap iterator.
Hashes the name through 0x15216c, scans cached hashes, tests names with 0x26b018 and returns the resource. Windows getFromCache uses TCacheMap::find.

Adjacent pointer comparisons via callback r5 with two extra arguments; swaps when callback returns false, repeats until unchanged or count passes. Six sortMaps branches call it; Windows uses std::sort on records.
Grows capacity through 0x188cfc, copy-constructs a 0xc08-byte GameSelectionHeadersStruct in data+size*0xc08, then increments size. getHeaders, sortMaps and setFilter append records.
Calls element cleanup at 0x187ccc, deletes backing pointer at +8, conditionally deletes receiver using the CodeWarrior destructor flag. Called for selection header vectors.
Copies point/rect arguments; null source calls screen-to-surface 0x27d384, null destination calls surface-to-screen 0x27d518, otherwise uses the lock/blit/unlock context at 0x26e908..0x26ea70.
Writes 16-bit depth, width 1024 and height 768 into three TOC globals and returns true; called by earlySetup.
Compares saved display preference at config+0x64, switches mode with 0x27cf80, updates 800x600 screen, writes preferences and realigns video buffers.
Forwards to 0x268f50, which sends core/unhk and core/kill notifications, shuts down services and calls imported ExitToShell. Used by earlyShutdown and quit paths.
Checks current process is frontmost through 0x269dd8; copies point from 0x27d178 or writes (-1,-1). Called by mouseManager::mouseCoords.
Same foreground check and (-1,-1) fallback as 0x20f12c, passing output directly to 0x27d178. Called by the Mac event pump.
Computes intersection of two four-long rectangles into output; returns false on empty horizontal or vertical overlap. Corresponding Windows callers use IntersectRect.
Wrapper calls 0x20ce04 then 0x20cd98; that unlocks the current surface with 0x275ff8 and invokes display teardown 0x20ccdc. Called by shutDown.
Starts hosting through 0x27b090, copies local player name/id, pumps sound/events until completion, and reports the explicit host-game error string on failure.
Reads transport pending-size +0x8e0, allocates buffer, receives through 0x27b668, logs sender/size, processes immediate messages or queues them through CDPlayHeroes::queueMsg.
Logs Sent Message to %d [%d bytes], maps player ID zero to -1 broadcast, sends buffer and size +0xc through 0x27b63c and converts status to boolean.
Logs dropped player, constructs message type 0x3f6/size 0x18 with supplied player ID, then calls CDPlayHeroes::queueMsg. Windows receiveSaveGame constructs CDestroyPlayerMsg.

Body is li r3,0; blr. Callers pass network player ID before handlePlayerDrop or destruction-message construction; corresponding Windows sites call g_dPlay->destroyPlayer. Mac stub semantics are explicit.
Clears completion byte, invokes transport 0x27b2ac, then pumps pollSound and process1WindowsMessage until completion. Called by onBeginGame.
Walks up to 16 transport player records, allocates name-plus-ID objects of size 0x104, copies names/IDs and passes each to the callback object. Used by updateCurrentPlayers and selection mode setup.
Allocates transport/session objects, selects AppleTalk or TCP setup using 3DO/HEROES3/1 and mnet identifiers, destroys failed transport and returns success.
Loads the GameRanger temporary launch record through 0x2a02b8, activates it via 0x2a0378, then tests host/guest state through 0x2a03d8. Called by oldmain.
Uses GameRanger host/guest flags and username/address getters; initializes remote state, then hosts or joins. Contains explicit GameRanger play-disc and host/guest log strings.
Checks deque length, allocates/grows pointer blocks, copies one message pointer into tail slot and increments size at +0x18. CDPlayHeroes::queueMsg passes its message pointer by reference.

Every 100 ticks updates three 0x5c-byte music records, adds volume delta, clamps or stops/pauses streams through 0x27e240/0x27df70/0x27e198, then updates the manager playback flag. serviceSounds forwards here.
Initializes 13 channels of stride 0x3c via 0x276ebc; adds all to one pool and groups them into three category pools with 0x277688.
Builds one text-entry connection dialog, invokes hostSession and 0x21056c join; failure string explicitly says Error initializing AppleTalk connection.
Builds the alternate two-text-entry connection dialog, invokes hostSession, then passes entered address and second field to 0x21056c. onJoin selects this versus the AppleTalk dialog.
Deletes indexed pixel array at receiver+0 and optionally receiver. videoShutDown owns it; neighboring methods convert its palette and blit indexed pixels.
Converts 256 RGB triples to RGB555 halfwords at receiver+4, eight entries per loop. Called when Smacker palette changes.
Rejects zero width/height, obtains surface pixels and pitch, offsets source/destination by x/y and calls 0x25e3a8 with the RGB555 palette at receiver+4.
Dequeues up to requested entries from a 256-slot ring of 0x18-byte records, dispatches to registered handlers, then runs idle callbacks at 0x269a70.
Constructs a list node owned by global+0x1828, installs vtable and stores supplied callback at +0x14. soundManager::open supplies the sound service callback.
Checks linked state via 0x269a60 and adds callback node through linked-list insertion at 0x26a8fc; returns 2 when already registered.
Checks linked state then removes callback node through 0x26a974; returns 2 when absent. soundManager::close invokes it.
Walks list at application global+0x1828, invokes each callback at node+0x14 through pointer glue and advances through 0x269a68.
Writes receiver and four arguments into a 256-entry ring, advances write index modulo 256 and updates free/pending counts; handles special receiver -2 via registered handler head.
Calls imported GetFrontProcess, GetCurrentProcess and SameProcess; returns the process-equality boolean.
Enumerates processes, finds signature MACS/type FNDR and sends aevt/quit via AECreateAppleEvent and AESend.
Loads handle at +4, returns *handle or null. getBitmap816/loadBitmap16 construct and allocate the same handle buffer through already identified 0x26aab0/0x26ab14 before invoking this accessor.
Copies source r4 to destination r3 including terminator, folding A..Z by +32. Quest descriptions and startMP3 call it; Windows uses lowercase string operations.
Compares bytes through the terminator and returns bool 0/1, unlike strcmp ordering. Used by cache lookup and MP3 name checks.
Gestalt otan/otvr checks require Open Transport version >=0x01110000, then test tcp or atlk availability bits. Multiplayer UI queries both protocols.
Calls OTInetGetInterfaceInfo, OTInetHostToString and optionally OTInetGetSecondaryAddresses; populates textual addresses. getIPAddress wraps it.
Sets context source pointer at +0 to null; companion methods at 0x26e968/0x26ea24 lock and release two surfaces.
Calls context unlock at 0x26ea24 and conditionally operator delete based on destructor flag.
Locks both surfaces, records pixels/pitches at +8/+0xc and +0x10/+0x14, and optional mask pixels/pitch at +0x18/+0x1c.
If source pointer is nonnull, unlocks both surfaces with 0x275ff8 and clears context source pointer.
Clips destination rectangle, adjusts source for flip flags, computes pixel offsets, selects optional mask, and calls a blitter from flag-indexed dispatch table.
Stores RGB bytes and packed RGB555, then precomputes packed channel multiples 1,3,5,7 used by blending/fill. Called for cursor and fade colors.
Three rotate/mask instructions combine high five bits of red/green/blue into RGB555, then return. mouseManager::open uses the result as a color.
At first lock obtains GWorld pixmap and calls LockPixels; increments lock count at +4.
Decrements lock count; at zero calls GetGWorldPixMap/UnlockPixels and clamps negative count to zero.
Returns receiver+8. NewGWorld constructor at 0x275c80 stores its width argument at +8 and height at +0xc.
Returns receiver+0xc; constructor at 0x275c80 stores height there and uses it for GWorld bounds and buffer size.
Requires nonzero lock count, calls GetGWorldPixMap/GetPixBaseAddr, stores pixels through output pointer; returns error 2 and null if unlocked.
Returns receiver+0x24; NewGWorld setup stores masked pixmap rowBytes there at 0x275d2c.
Locks surface, obtains pixels, fills receiver+0x28 halfwords with the packed color using 0x26ac98, then unlocks.
Calls imported SysBeep with duration 0x45; used on failed GameRanger launch.
Clears reference count and sound-data pointer at +0/+4; sample constructor invokes it before loading stream data.
Calls 0x276cc0 release, then conditionally deletes receiver according to destructor flag.
Reads stream signature through virtual read/seek; dispatches proprietary sound, RIFF/WAVE, FORM/AIFF and FORM/AIFC loaders into receiver+4/+8.
Stops all channels referencing this sample, drains its reference count through 0x276db0, deletes the byte array at +4 and clears it.
Stops sample, calls SndDisposeChannel, clears channel handle +0x14 and unlinks channel from registry.
Initializes playback, issues SndDoImmediate/SndDoCommand using sample data, advances play-generation ID at +0x28 and sets playing flag at +0x18.
Checks playing flag, sends Sound Manager flush/quiet/callback commands, clears play flags and releases sample reference; behavior depends on requested stop mode.
Returns true iff playing flag +0x18 is set and caller generation equals channel generation +0x28.
Stores float volume at +0x2c, loads pan +0x30 and calls 0x277538 with the Sound Manager channel handle.
Scans pool for initialized idle channel; optionally returns channel with oldest generation when no idle channel exists.
Scans pool and calls 0x27725c to return the channel matching a live play-generation ID, otherwise null.
Walks pool entries and calls 0x27713c with immediate stop mode for every nonnull channel.
Copies 0x46 bytes from supplied FSSpec into receiver+8, clears open/dirty state and marks file object initialized.
If open, calls FSClose, clears open count and FlushVol when dirty. Used by save-game and preference file paths.
Calls FSWrite with requested byte count, translates errors, marks dirty and reports short write as error 0x14.
Maps seek origin 0/1/2 to Mac position modes 1/2/3 and invokes SetFPos on file reference at +2.
Invokes GetEOF using file reference at +2 and returns length, or zero on error.
Closes open fork via 0x277e8c, invokes FSpDelete on receiver+8 and resets file adapter through 0x277dd0.
BlockMoveData copies 0x46 bytes from receiver+8 to caller output. setupCDDrive and stream creation use it.
PBHGetFInfoSync obtains modification timestamp, SecondsToDate converts it, then copies seven date/time shorts into output.
Clears initialized byte; preference paths construct this object before FindFolder or directory open.
Calls directory close 0x278584 and conditionally deletes receiver using destructor flag.
Builds FSSpec for supplied directory, resolves aliases, creates missing directory with FSpDirCreate, closes prior state and adopts volume/directory IDs.
Calls FindFolder on system disk with caller folder type/create flag; stores volume/directory IDs at +2/+4 and marks initialized.
Calls PBGetCatInfoSync with directory index -1, then converts Pascal name through 0x26b210; returns empty output on error.
Clears initialized byte; loadCampaignList/getHeaders/getRandomMapName construct this before enumeration.
Calls enumeration close at 0x278758 then conditionally deletes receiver.
Sets catalog index 1, stores directory pointer at +0x44, copies search mask at +4 and sets active byte.
Clears active byte and returns zero. Called after file-search loops and by the enumerator destructor.
Calls PBGetCatInfoSync with advancing index, converts Pascal name, filters through 0x26b048, returns FSSpec and file/folder metadata.
Installs stream vtable and clears open flag at +4. loadSample uses this stack stream.
Restores stream vtable, invokes close slot through pointer glue, and conditionally deletes receiver.
Copies source FSSpec, opens embedded file adapter at +0x14, validates offset/length against EOF, seeks to slice start and records length/position/base offset.
When open flag +4 is set, closes embedded file adapter at +0x14 and clears the flag.
Calls transport shutdown at 0x27afb4 then conditionally operator delete. remoteCleanup passes destructor flag 1.
Transitions between modes 0/1/2 using paired leave/enter routines, broadcasts before/after notifications and records selected mode at global+0x14.
Returns mode at display global+0x14, the value changed by 0x27cf80. Mouse/fade code branches on it.
Builds point/rect from arguments, loads global back surface at +0x18 and calls 0x27d384 screen-to-surface copy.
Uses DSpGetMouse and DSpContext_GlobalToLocal in fullscreen, or GetMouse/FindWindow/GlobalToLocal in windowed mode; returns long x/y point.
Converts caller point through DSpContext_LocalToGlobal or temporary window port plus LocalToGlobal, according to display mode.
Selects fullscreen front buffer or window port, locks destination surface, calls CopyBits from screen to its pixmap, unlocks and restores port/device.
Selects front buffer/window destination, locks source surface, calls CopyBits from its pixmap to display, unlocks and restores port/device.
Requires fullscreen mode, stores supplied RGB fade color, calls DSpContext_FadeGamma and stores fade amount at display global+0x1fc.
Stops stream through virtual callback, disposes sound channel, closes file reference and unlinks stream registration. Called on music fade completion and sound shutdown.
Seven-argument destination-buffer setup, null-buffer cleanup and Smack fields/flags; matches retained source SmackToBuffer calls in videoRealignBuffers/showVideo. Returns at 0x297770.
Consumes decoder dirty-rectangle list and copies four-word rectangle to Smack public fields, returning whether another rectangle exists; videoDrawRects loops on this API.
Builds AppleEvent class GRgr/id Redy, sends it and sets ready flag. Called when selection dialog becomes ready.
Builds GRgr/GEnd event with elapsed GTim, Scor and AScr parameters, sends it and disposes descriptors during remote cleanup.
Builds GRgr/HCls event after host-state check, sends it and disposes descriptors during remote cleanup.
Searches running processes and desktop application database for creator GRgr/type APPL, caching application location and availability for multiplayer UI.
Finds GRgr process and SetFrontProcess, otherwise searches desktop database and LaunchApplication; pumps WaitNextEvent around activation.
